name: consentledger
description: Control plane for AI agents that spend money: agents propose, humans sign with passkeys, PayPal settles.

scripts.test:int: node -e "if (!process.env.DATABASE_URL) { console.error('\n  test:int requires DATABASE_URL. Run pnpm db:up first, then set DATABASE_URL.\n  Skipping integration tests.'); process.exit(0); } require('child_process').execSync('vitest run --project integration', { stdio: 'inherit' });"
